reuse.intent: Share bounded local Git process/stream ownership without merging resolver policy or panelist consent/declaration policy.
reuse.public_contract: Invoke-SddGitRaw(RepoRoot,GitArgs) returns ExitCode and raw Stdout/Stderr bytes; literal argv, concurrent streams and a shared30second deadline; invocation failures throw for caller-specific mapping.
reuse.stability_evidence: Two current production consumers and retained actual resolver/panelist regressions; source-bound review in coverage.python-assist-large.json. Long-term public API or universal native-platform stability is not claimed.
reuse.consumer_requirements: Resolver needs strict UTF8/NUL diff parsing and GitDiffError classification; panelist needs exact historical bytes for hashing and conservative nonzero/no-history behavior. Both require non-shell argv and bounded completion.
reuse.divergence_counterexample: Interactive credential prompts, streaming network providers or callers requiring a different timeout/retry contract cannot be silently routed through this finite local Git inspection helper.
reuse.decision: Reuse the raw-byte Git mechanism in existing native-arguments.ps1; keep caller validation, decoding, retry and admission decisions separate.
reuse.reason: Transport/lifecycle invariant is shared by actual consumers; feature-specific state machines and fallback meanings remain independently owned.
reuse.verification: Actual Linux sleeping-Git direct-child deadline control plus resolver78/diff20/parity25/panelist185 and native analyzer. Tree-kill fallback and Windows5.1 behavior are explicitly not independently proven.
